Education Ministry Forms Panel to Investigate IIIT Ranchi Student Death

The Union Ministry of Education has formed a three-member committee to investigate the death of a student at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The ministry has taken cognizance of the incident and will examine the circumstances surrounding the death and related aspects, including student welfare measures.
